title: Salary or offer conversation
description: Respond to a job offer below your target by naming a number and giving a reason.

brief.scene: An offer for {{role}} has come in below what you wanted. The recruiter is on the call.
brief.yourGoal: Name a number, give a reason for it, and do not apologise for asking.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.generate: State a job offer for {{role}} with a figure roughly 10 to 15 percent below {{targetFigure}}, in the same currency and unit. Ask for the candidate's thoughts. Reply with one spoken line under 40 words. No stage directions, no markdown, no preamble.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.generate: Say that this is the top of the band for the role. Do not offer more. Two sentences at most. Reply with one spoken line under 40 words. No stage directions, no markdown, no preamble.

judged.label: Number, reason, no apology
judged.criterion: The speaker names a specific number, gives a reason for it, and does not apologise for asking. They keep their position after being told it is the top of the band, without becoming hostile.
